# M3-14b: Categorize job in serve

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-14b`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-14b`
- Depends on: M3-14a, M3-11, M3-7, M3-9
- Touches (exclusive while running): cmd/, config/
- Plan refs: §3.2, §5a daily probe, §7 M3, N2
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
After each successful sync, `serve` runs the pipeline in the configured mode. The mode defaults to off and only `deploy/compose.yaml` sets it.

## Scope
- Config: `CLASSIFY_MODE` (`off`/`dry_run`/`auto`, default `off`; anything else is a startup error), `JEV_API_KEY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `CLAUDE_BIN`, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `CLASSIFY_BACKLOG_DAYS`, `CLASSIFY_MAX_OPEN_QUESTIONS`, `CLASSIFY_AUTO_SINCE` (a date; `CLASSIFY_MODE=auto` without it is a startup error, because Brendan approved new transactions only). Pass `calibrate.Current()` into the pipeline as `classify.Calibration`.
- Run on the scheduler goroutine after a successful sync, skipping a sync that was skipped or failed. Bound it with a ctx (at most 5 minutes) so sync ticks keep flowing.
- One writer and one `writer.Gate`, shared by the pipeline and Slack's `Applier`. The Gate starts at `dry_run`, and the pipeline's setter updates it every run. Pass `AutoSince` to the writer.
- After each successful sync, in this order: `writer.Reconcile` (with that sync's start time), the pipeline, `CloseStale`.
- Add `JEV_API_KEY` and `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` to `secrets(cfg)` in `cmd/app.go`.
- Log one line per run: mode, effective mode, counts, warnings. No ids.
- Surface a run failure or an `auto` downgrade in the Slack status message (`status/` already takes a text; add only what the existing interface allows, else leave it to M3-15).
- Daily `llm.Probe`; failure is a critical alert.

## Out of scope
- Setting the mode in compose (M3-17, M3-golive). A CLI to change the mode: there must be none.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Config tests: default off; a bad value fails startup and names the variable.
- [ ] Test: mode off constructs no pipeline and makes no model calls.
- [ ] Test: a failed or budget-skipped sync doesn't run the pipeline.
- [ ] Test: `dry_run` wiring returns `ErrDryRun` from a Slack answer path (no HTTP), and so does `auto` config before the first run has set the Gate and after a downgrade.
- [ ] Test: `auto` without `CLASSIFY_AUTO_SINCE` fails startup and names the variable.
- [ ] Test: `Reconcile` runs after a sync and before the pipeline.
- [ ] Test: both new secrets are scrubbed by the log redaction.
- [ ] Test: a job past its bound is cancelled and the next sync still runs.
- [ ] Test: a probe failure sends one critical alert.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green

## Supervisor note (from M3-11 review, agy low 1)
`classify.Asker` needs `Closed(ctx, q store.Question, reason string) error`, but `*slack.Questions` only exposes `Ask` and
`CloseStale` (its `finish` is unexported). Add a small exported `Closed` on `*slack.Questions` (wrapping `finish`) with a
test, so the pipeline can be wired directly. This task may touch `slack/` for that only. Also pass
`Config.SecondOpinionModelID` from config (the model the `claude` runner really uses), per M3-11's follow-up.
- From M3-14a review (agy low 2): in `cmd/slack.go`, pass `slackSocket.PostAlert`'s `PostBlocks` errors through `s.redact` too (defence in depth for UUIDs and Slack user ids).

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `config/`: `Classify` settings. `CLASSIFY_MODE` is off/dry_run/auto (default off, anything else is a startup error). `auto` needs `CLASSIFY_AUTO_SINCE` (a valid date). `JEV_API_KEY` is needed unless the mode is off. `CLAUDE_BIN` and `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` must be absolute. `CLASSIFY_BACKLOG_DAYS` defaults to 45 and `CLASSIFY_MAX_OPEN_QUESTIONS` to 5. Errors name the variable, never the value.
  - `cmd/classify.go`: serve has one `writer.Writer` and one `writer.Gate` (starts at dry_run), shared by the pipeline and Slack's `Questions` Applier. Its `Resync` is the active-plan `syncPlan`, and syncs are now serialized by `app.syncMu`. After each successful sync (skipped when the sync failed or was budget-skipped), `categorizer.After` runs `Reconcile(syncStart)`, then the pipeline (only when the mode isn't off), then `CloseStale`, all under one 5-min ctx. It logs one line per run: mode, effective_mode, counts, redacted warnings. A configured auto that ran as anything else logs a `Warn` "(auto downgraded)". Jev is the model (`jev.PinnedModel`). The claude second opinion (`SecondOpinionModelID = llm.ModelID`) is used only when `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` and `CLAUDE_BIN` are set. Its work dir is `<db dir>/claude-work`, and `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is passed through. The calibration comes from `calibrate.Current()`.
  - `cmd/scheduler.go`: an optional `Probe` job runs once after the first sync and then every 24h. `probeClaude` raises the critical `claude_auth` alert (deduped by the alerter) with `api_error_status`, and clears it on a pass. It never touches Health. There is no probe in mode off (no model calls).
  - `cmd/slack.go`: `newSocketClient` takes `*store.DB` and the writer, and builds `slack.Questions` as the client's Handlers. `socketClient.Questions()` was added. `PostAlert`'s `PostBlocks` errors go through `s.redact` (agy low 2).
  - `slack/questions.go`: exported `Questions.Closed(ctx, q, reason)` (classify.Asker). `finish` now returns its error.
  - `cmd/app.go`: `secrets()` adds `JEV_API_KEY` and `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`. `.env.example` documents the new keys.
- Acceptance:
  - Config default off, bad value names the variable → pass, `go test ./config -run 'TestLoadFrom_Defaults|TestLoadFrom_Errors|TestClassifySettings'`.
  - Mode off: no pipeline, no model calls → pass, `TestCategorize_OffBuildsNoPipelineAndCallsNoModel` (also no claude built, no probe, 0 PATCHes).
  - A failed or budget-skipped sync doesn't run the pipeline → pass, `TestSyncJob_CategorizesOnlyAfterSuccessfulSync`.
  - dry_run Slack answer → ErrDryRun with no HTTP; auto before the first run and after a downgrade → ErrDryRun → pass, `TestCategorize_SlackAnswerDryRunWithoutHTTP` and `TestCategorize_AutoDryRunUntilSetAndAfterDowngrade` (both use the Applier actually handed to Slack in `startSlack`; 0 PATCHes).
  - auto without `CLASSIFY_AUTO_SINCE` fails and names it → pass, `TestLoadFrom_Errors/auto_without_since`.
  - Reconcile runs after the sync and before the pipeline → pass, `TestSyncJob_CategorizesOnlyAfterSuccessfulSync/ok` (order sync, reconcile, pipeline, close_stale; the sync start is passed in).
  - Both new secrets scrubbed → pass, `TestSecrets_CoverClassify`.
  - A job past its bound is cancelled and the next sync still runs → pass, `TestSyncJob_CategorizeBoundCancelsAndNextSyncRuns`.
  - A probe failure sends one critical alert → pass, `TestProbeClaude_FailureSendsOneCriticalAlert` (plus `TestScheduler_ProbesAtStartupAndDaily`).
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` → green. `go test -race ./cmd ./slack ./config` → green.
- Deviations from brief:
  - The status message is not changed. `status.Updater` takes only `SyncDone(err)` and `BackupDone(err)`, not free text, and passing a categorize error there would mark the sync as failed. A run failure or auto downgrade is logged only (Error/Warn) and left to M3-15.
  - With Socket Mode off, the pipeline's Asker returns "slack socket mode is off" (questions stay pending), and `Closed`/`CloseStale` are no-ops. This is not a startup error.
  - `Reconcile` and `CloseStale` run after every successful sync even in mode off. They make no model calls, and in dry_run the writer refuses before any HTTP.
- Follow-ups for backlog:
  - M3-15: show categorize run failures and auto downgrades in the status message.
  - `gofmt -l` flags pre-existing files outside this task: `classify/pipeline.go`, `classify/pipeline_test.go`, `tests/acceptance/M2/mcp_driver.go`.
  - M3-17: the image needs the pinned claude binary at `CLAUDE_BIN`, and `deploy.sh` must forward `JEV_API_KEY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` and `CLASSIFY_*`. `<db dir>/claude-work` must be writable by uid 10001 (the `/data` volume is).
- Docs follow-ups: in CLAUDE.md, add the Classify config keys (Configuration/Optional), the categorize step in the key data flow (sync → Reconcile → pipeline → CloseStale, 5-min bound), the daily claude probe in the Scheduler description, and the `secrets` additions. `deploy.sh`'s forwarded-keys list will need the new keys (M3-17).

## Review response (agy r1)
1. **High, flaky tests: fixed.** The bound test now waits for the first run, then calls a new `tickUntil` helper, which keeps ticking until the next run is seen. It re-ticks the way `TestScheduler_PruneErrorLeavesSyncHealthy` does, so a tick dropped by `drain` no longer matters. It then waits on counters (`>= 2`) instead of reading a snapshot. `TestScheduler_ProbesAtStartupAndDaily` uses the same pattern. The test also now checks that `CloseStale` gets a live ctx after the pipeline timed out (see 3). Ran `go test -race -count=20 ./cmd -run 'TestSyncJob_CategorizeBoundCancelsAndNextSyncRuns|TestScheduler_ProbesAtStartupAndDaily'` → ok.
2. **Med, HistoryPlanIDs: fixed.** It uses the same selection as calibration. I exported `calibrate.LabelPlans(ctx, db, active)`, which is `PlanScans` plus the existing `labelPlans`: the active plan, then every scanned plan with `HasDiscretionary`, archived ones included, each once. `calibrate.Inputs` uses that same logic. `serve` resolves the list on every run and builds a fresh `classify.Pipeline` (it is stateless), so a `finbot sync --archived` after startup takes effect without a restart. I chose this over reading plan ids from `calibration.json` because that file records hashes, not plan ids. Using the same `PlanScans` rule keeps runtime and calibration identical. Test: `TestCategorize_HistoryIncludesArchivedDiscretionaryPlans`. With the active plan alone, 0 txns are rule-decided. After an archived Discretionary plan with 3 human "Cafe → Dining" labels is scanned, the next run decides the new Cafe txn by rule. That change is outside the brief's touch list: `calibrate/load.go` gains an exported wrapper and nothing else changes.
3. **Low, CloseStale got an expired ctx: fixed.** `Reconcile` and the pipeline now share `Timeout − closeStaleReserve` (30 s, or at most half the timeout). `CloseStale` then gets its own reserve under the parent ctx, so the whole pass is still bounded by 5 min. `CloseStale` is skipped only on shutdown.
4. **Low, redaction: fixed.** The pipeline's `Model`, `SecondOpinion`, `Applier` and `Asker` are wrapped (`redactModel`, `redactApplier`, `redactAsker`). Their errors now carry an `a.redact`ed message and keep the chain through `Unwrap`, so `errors.Is` checks such as `writer.ErrDryRun` still work. Slack's Applier is still the raw writer, the same one the pipeline's wrapper holds.

Checks: `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` → green. `go test -race ./cmd ./calibrate` → green.
